topic: Reporting a Missing Item in an Order

script.title: THE MISSING PITCHER
script.scene_zh: 線上客服 · 補寄缺件
script.story_hook: The box arrived, but one thing inside never did.
script.intro_zh: 包裹送到了，裡頭卻少了一樣東西。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to today's support chat scene. Listen for useful complaint phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今天的線上客服場景。留意實用的申訴說法。
script.outro: One pitcher found, one happy customer. Listen again and repeat along.
script.outro_zh: 玻璃壺找到了，顧客也開心了。再聽一遍，一起跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat each line out loud now.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們逐句大聲跟讀。
script.title_quote: It's a Kitchen Tool, Not a Cat
script.char_a_description: a busy mom in her thirties with black hair tied in a messy claw clip, round gold earrings, a soft lavender cardigan over a white tee, reading glasses on a chain, and a medium build
script.char_b_description: a calm support agent in his forties with short buzz-cut dark hair, thin rectangular glasses, a neatly pressed light blue shirt, a slim headset on one ear, and a tall lean build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, um, part of my order never showed up.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ʌm pɑɹt əv maɪ ˈɔɹdɚ nɛvɚ ʃoʊd ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，那個，我訂的其中一項沒有送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, I'm sorry about that. Order number?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ aɪm ˈsɑɹi əbaʊt ðæt ˈɔɹdɚ ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，很抱歉。請問訂單編號？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's five-five-double-seven, placed last Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts faɪv faɪv ˈdəbl sɛvən pleɪst læst ˈtuzˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 是 5577，上週二下的單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. What's missing from the box?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt wʌts ˈmɪsɪŋ fɹəm ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 查到囉。箱子裡少了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The little glass pitcher, the recipe book's fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɪɾəl ɡlæs ˈpɪtʃɚ ðə ˈɛsəpi bʊks faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那組小玻璃壺不見了，食譜書倒是沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, that helps. Is the outer box damaged?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ðæt hɛlps ɪz ði ˈaʊtɚ bɑks ˈdæmədʒd/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，這對我有幫助。外包裝有破損嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, there's a big hole on one side.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ðɛrz ə bɪɡ hoʊl ɑn wʌn saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，箱子其中一個側面破了個大洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, that's likely how the pitcher escaped.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðæts ˈlaɪkli haʊ ðə ˈpɪtʃɚ ɪˈskeɪpt/
dialogue.zh: 啊，玻璃壺大概就是從那裡溜走的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Escaped? It's a kitchen tool, not a cat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈskeɪpt ɪts ə ˈkɪtʃən tul nɑt ə kæt/
dialogue.zh: 溜走？那是廚房器具，又不是貓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, fair point, sorry, let me fix this.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɛɹ pɔɪnt ˈsɑɹi lɛt mi fɪks ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 哈，說得是，抱歉，我來處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, can you send the missing piece?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kən ju sɛnd ðə ˈmɪsɪŋ pis/
dialogue.zh: 所以，你們能補寄缺的那件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Could you snap two quick photos first?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kʊd ju snæp tu kwɪk ˈfoʊtoʊz fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 可以！能請您先快拍兩張照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photos of the box or the stuff inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊz ʌv ðə bɑks ɔɹ ðə sʌf ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 是拍箱子，還是裡面的東西？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, please, plus the shipping label.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ pliz plʌs ðə ˈʃɪpɪŋ ˈleɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 都要麻煩您，再加一張物流標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, sent. The label was half torn off.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ sɛnt ðə ˈleɪbəl wəz hæf tɔɹn ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 好，傳過去囉。標籤已經撕掉一半了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see them, thank you. One second here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ðɛm θæŋk ju wʌn ˈsɛkənd hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 看到了，謝謝您。請等我一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your time, I'm sitting on the floor anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔɹ taɪm aɪm ˈsɪɾɪŋ ɑn ðə flɔɹ ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 您慢慢來，我反正正坐在地板上，不急。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it, your pitcher shipped separately, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt jɔɹ ˈpɪtʃɚ ʃɪpt ˈsɛpɚɾli ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，您的玻璃壺其實是另有出貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Separately? Then why does it say delivered?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛpɚɾli ðɛn waɪ dʌz ɪt seɪ dɪˈlɪvɚd/
dialogue.zh: 另有出貨？那為什麼顯示已送達？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good question. Um, it shows 'exception' at our warehouse.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈkwɛsʧən ʌm ɪt ʃoʊz ɪkˈsɛpʃən æt ˈaʊɚ ˈwɛrˌhaʊs/
dialogue.zh: 好問題。嗯，倉庫端顯示「異常」。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exception meaning... it's still sitting on a shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈsɛpʃən ˈminɪŋ ɪs stɪl ˈsɪɾɪŋ ɑn ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 異常的意思是……它還留在倉庫架上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly right, and I'm so sorry about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ɹaɪt ænd aɪm soʊ ˈsɑɹi əbaʊt ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 完全正確，真的非常抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, how do we solve it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl haʊ du wi sɑlv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那，我們該怎麼解決？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two options: a replacement today, or a refund.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈɑpʃənz ə ɹɪˈpleɪsmənt təˈdeɪ ɔɹ ə ˈɹiˌfʌnd/
dialogue.zh: 兩個做法：今天補寄新品，或是退款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The refund would be just for the pitcher?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈɹiˌfʌnd wʊd bi dʒʌst fɚ ðə ˈpɪtʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 退款只退玻璃壺那部分嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, fifteen dollars back to your card.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs fɪfˈtin ˈdɑləz bæk tə jɔɹ kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 對，十五美元退回您的卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the replacement, when would it arrive?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ɹɪˈpleɪsmənt wɛn wʊd ɪt əˈɹaɪv/
dialogue.zh: 那補寄的話，什麼時候會到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Normally three to five business days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɔɪməli θɹi tə faɪv ˈbɪznəs deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 一般要三到五個工作天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that won't work, I need it by Saturday.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæt woʊnt wɝk aɪ nid ɪt baɪ ˈsætɚˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那不行，我週六前就要用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For a... urgent smoothie situation?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ ɹ ə ˈɝdʒənt ˈsmuˌði sɪˈtʃueɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 是為了……急上大場的奶昔工程嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My kid's bake sale! She's counting on me.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɪdz beɪk seɪl ʃi z ˈkaʊnɾɪŋ ɑn mi/
dialogue.zh: 我孩子在辦烘焙義賣！她全指望我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, that changes things. Let me upgrade the shipping.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðæt ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz θɪŋz lɛt mi ˈʌpˌɡɹeɪd ðə ˈʃɪpɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好，那就不一樣了。我幫您升級配送。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you do that?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən ju du ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 你們可以做到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, overnight at no charge for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ˈoʊvɚˌnaɪt æt noʊ tʃɑɹdʒ fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 可以，隔日送達，不另收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, really? That would save the whole weekend.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ˈɹɪli ðæt wʊd seɪv ðə hoʊl ˈwikˌɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 等等，真的嗎？那整個週末都得救了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, it leaves in tomorrow morning's batch.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ɪt livz ɪn təˈmɑɹoʊ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ bætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 辦好了，它搭上明早的出貨批次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So it arrives Friday, if all goes well?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪt əˈɹaɪvz ˈfɹɑˌdeɪ ɪf ɔl ɡoʊz wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 所以順利的話，週五就能到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday, actually, since it's overnight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝzˌdeɪ ˈæktʃuəli sɪns ɪts ˈoʊvɚˌnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 其實是週四啦，畢竟是隔日送。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even better! Do I need to do anything else?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ˈbɛɾɚ du aɪ nid tə du ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 那更好！我還有別的要做嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just keep the box till Thursday, um, in case.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst kip ðə bɑks tɪl ˈθɝzˌdeɪ ʌm ɪn keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 請先留著箱子到週四，嗯，以防萬一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In case my cat adopts the packing peanuts?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn keɪs maɪ kæt əˈdɑpts ðə ˈpækɪŋ ˈpinʌts/
dialogue.zh: 以防我的貓把保麗龍粒當新家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, in case the courier asks for it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɪn keɪs ðə ˈkʊɹiɚ æsks fɚ ɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 哈，以防快遞人員要把箱子回收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, but the cat claims the box tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn bʌt ðə kæt kleɪmz ðə bɑks təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，不過貓今晚就會進駐那個箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cats always win. Should I refund the shipping too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæts ˈɔlweɪz wɪn ʃʊd aɪ ɹɪˈfʌnd ðə ˈʃɪpɪŋ tu/
dialogue.zh: 貓總是大贏家。運費也要一起退嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, I did pay five for delivery here.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪ dɪ peɪ faɪv fɚ dɪˈlɪvɚi hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，我確實付了五美元運費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's on us, so it goes right back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɑn ʌs soʊ ɪt ɡoʊz ɹaɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 這是我們的疏失，運費立刻退回。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've turned a bad day around, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊv tɝnd ə bæd deɪ əˈɹaʊnd ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，你把我這糟心的一天救回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Team effort, the warehouse owes me one now.
dialogue.phonetic: /tim ˈɛfɚt ðə ˈwɛrˌhaʊs oʊz mi wʌn naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 團隊合作啦，倉庫現在欠我一次人情。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I get an email about the new tracking?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl aɪ ɡɛt æn ˈimeɪl əbaʊt ðə nju ˈtɹækɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我會收到新追蹤單號的郵件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, within the hour, from this same address.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɪˈðɪn ði ˈaʊɚ fɹəm ðɪs seɪm əˈdɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 會的，一小時內，就用這個信箱發給您。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, and um, can I message you again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ænd ʌm kən aɪ ˈmɛsɪdʒ ju əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，嗯，我之後還能傳訊息找你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, just reply to that email anytime.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs dʒʌst ɹɪˈplaɪ tə ðæt ˈimeɪl ˈɛniˌtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，隨時回覆那封郵件就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. My kid says thanks, she heard that!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt maɪ kɪd sɛz θæŋk ʃi hɝd ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我孩子說謝謝，她剛都聽到啦！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her the pitcher is racing to her kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɚ ðə ˈpɪtʃɚ ɪz ˈɹeɪsɪŋ tə hɚ ˈkɪtʃən/
dialogue.zh: 告訴她，玻璃壺正飛奔往她的廚房去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Have a nice rest of your shift.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl hæv ə naɪs rɛst ʌv jɔɹ ʃɪft/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。也祝你剩下的班順利愉快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too, and good luck at the bake sale.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tu ænd ɡʊd lʊk æt ðə beɪk seɪl/
dialogue.zh: 你也是，烘焙義賣大賣喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks again for not giving me a script.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks əˈɡɛn fɚ nɑt ˈɡɪvɪŋ mi ə skɹɪpt/
dialogue.zh: 再次謝謝你沒有跟我念制式稿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scripts are for plays, you get a human.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɹɪpts ɑɹ fɚ pleɪz ju ɡɛt ə ˈhumən/
dialogue.zh: 劇本是留給話劇的，您接通的是真人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A very patient human, apparently.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈvɛɹi ˈpeɪʃənt ˈhumən ˈæpəˈɹɛntli/
dialogue.zh: 顯然還是位很有耐心的真人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye! Hope Thursday comes fast for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ hoʊp ˈθɝzˌdeɪ kʌmz fæst fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 再見！但願週四對您來說快一點。

script.youtube_title: 【包裹少了一樣😱】「又不是貓！」客服隔日補寄大救援📦📷｜拍照・退款・升級配送全學會｜60句沉浸英文聽力｜Reporting a Missing Item in an Order
script.youtube_title_en: "It's a Kitchen Tool, Not a Cat" — Reporting a Missing Item
script.youtube_description:
「又不是貓，怎麼會溜走？」——網購少了一樣東西，該怎麼用英文找客服解決？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在家裡的開箱現場與線上客服對話。

你會聽到：報訂單編號、說明缺了哪件商品；依客服要求拍照存證；聽懂「分開發貨」與「倉庫異常」；在退款與補寄之間做選擇；請客服升級成隔日送達、順便退回運費的完整說法。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，自然出現美國人對話中的 um、well、so、ha。聽完你就會用：Order number?、Can you send the missing piece?、That's on us、Good luck at the bake sale。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴噹。
script.youtube_description_en:
"It's a kitchen tool, not a cat!" — how do you report a missing item from an online order in English? This is a 60-line immersive listening practice, straight from a living-room unboxing to a live support chat.

You will hear: giving your order number, describing exactly what went missing, taking photos when support asks, learning that the pitcher shipped separately with a warehouse exception, and choosing between a refund and a replacement. Then comes the best part: a free overnight upgrade and a shipping refund.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with real American rhythm: um, well, so, ha. By the end you'll own phrases like Order number?, Can you send the missing piece?, That's on us, and Reply to that email anytime.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
包裹到了，箱子卻破了一個洞，裡頭的小玻璃壺不見了！找客服要怎麼說清楚？要拍照？要退款？還是補寄？週六前遲到可就來不及了！

這一集帶大家經歷一次完整的網購缺件申訴：報訂單、說明缺件、拍照求證、聽見「倉庫異常」，再到升級隔日配送、退回運費，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📦 報修開頭：Hi, um, part of my order never showed up.
📷 拍照求證：Could you snap two quick photos first?
🚚 升級配送：Okay, that changes things. Let me upgrade the shipping.
💵 運費退回：That's on us, so it goes right back.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。下次你的包裹少了一樣東西，這些英文會自己從嘴邊冒出來。

祝你每個包裹都完好送達。
